texts.zh:
我们最近在我们最大的城市之一发生了一长小型灾难，并迅速制造了难以言说的毁坏。为了将其修复如初，我们正寻找愿意向我们贡献材料的人，让我们开始重建工作。

当然，我们会慷慨地想愿意帮助我们的人支付酬劳。不仅如此，我们还可以派出一队工程师与你们的人民分享我们的一部分秘密。
texts.en:
We have recently seen a small calamity happen in one of our greatest cities, leaving untold destruction in its wake. To restore it to former glory, we are looking for people willing to send materials our way, so we can begin the reconstruction.

We will, of course, pay quite handsomely to anyone willing to help us out. Not only that, but we can send a team of engineers to share some of our secrets with your people.

label.zh: 我们可以为你们的人民拨出一部分资源。
label.en: We will set aside some materials for your people.

tooltips.zh: 在加来的10年内，我们可以在一个居住站上发起晶态建设决议。
tooltips.en: For the next 10 years we will be able to enact the Crystalline Construction decision on a Habitat.

texts.zh:
我们很高兴知道你们愿意提供帮助。你们的礼物可以帮助数以百万计的泽阿亚基。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are happy to hear you are willing to help us out. Your gift will help millions of lost Zer-Ayaki.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

texts.zh: 你们还有什么想和我们讨论的吗？
texts.en: What else did you want to discuss with us?

texts.zh: 你现在站在晶态帝国外环舰队指挥官、内陆之守护者的面前。有什么是你想与我们讨论的吗？
texts.en: You stand in front of the Commander of the Outer Circle Armada of the Crystalline Empire, Protector of the Inner Lands. What is it you wish to discuss with us?

label.zh: 能不能告诉我更多关于你们家园的事？
label.en: Could you tell us more about your homeland?

responses.zh:
我们的家园如泡沫幻影，如果我们告诉你太多，将会给它带来末日。你们这些年轻的种族在被允许进入那座圣所之前还有很多需要学习的。

如果你们证明了自己的价值，有朝一日我们会将向你们揭示一切的真理。
responses.en:
Our homeland is like a dream, and if we were to tell you much more about it, that would be the end of it. You younger races still have much to learn before you can be allowed into the sanctum.

One day, if you prove worthy, we will be able to show you the truth of everything.

responses.zh:
我们长期以来观察着星系中的其他种族，并且我们在现在的邻居中看到了潜能。当我们收到信息，这些年轻种族中有一个就是我们在等待的那个，我们立刻就准备好了找到他们。

我们还不确定你们这些年轻种族中到底谁是我们正在寻找的，但是我们相信你们都有能力向我们证明自己。希望你们不要辜负我们的期望，而我们可以找到我们都能够接受的条件。
responses.en:
We have long watched over the other races in the galaxy, and we see potential in our current neighbors. When the messenger arrived with news that one of the younger races was the one we had waited for, we immediately prepared to track them down.

We are not certain which one of you younger races is the one we are looking for, yet, but we believe all of you can prove useful for us. Hopefully you will be able to live up to the expectations we have for you, and we can find terms that both of us will be happy with.

label.zh: 有什么你们在找的，或者需要我们帮忙的吗？
label.en: Is there anything you are looking for, or need our help with?

responses.zh: 没有，时机还没成熟。我们晚些时候再回来，希望那时我们向你能分享更多消息。
responses.en: No, the time for that is not now. Come back later, and hopefully we will be able to share more news with you.

label.zh: 有什么你们在找的，或者需要我们帮忙的吗？
label.en: Is there anything you are looking for, or need our help with?

texts.zh:
我们很遗憾你们不愿意提供帮助。我们只能再去其他地方寻找帮助了。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are sorry to hear that you are not willing to help us out. We will look elsewhere for help, then.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.
